items.title: Stock market holiday: NSE, BSE to remain closed for Diwali-Balipratipada
items.description: Stock market holiday today: Stock markets will remain closed on Tuesday, November 10, on account of Diwali-Balipratipada.

items.title: World stocks rise as oil slips below $90 on hopes of US-Iran peace talks
items.description: European and US equity futures gain as easing oil prices lift investor sentiment ahead of US inflation data that could shape expectations for the Federal Reserve's interest rate outlook

items.title: Bullish signals! GIFT Nifty jumps 1% as crude oil prices test $90/bbl
items.description: A decline in oil could also influence the ​interest rate outlook amid easing inflation fears.

items.title: Apollo Hospitals stock supported by expansion, value unlocking triggers
items.description: Revenue rose 23 per cent in Q2FY27, while improving occupancy, new-bed additions and better HealthCo economics are expected to support growth and margins

items.title: Asian stocks rise amid falling oil prices on hopes of US-Iran talks
items.description: Asian markets gained as Brent crude slipped 1% to $91.56 a barrel after Trump signalled a pause in further military strikes against Iran, easing inflation concerns ahead of key US price data

items.title: Tata Steel to Hindalco: Brokerages' Diwali picks for Samvat 2083
items.description: November rally has brought a festive glow to equities. Brokerages identify their potential winners for Samvat 2083

items.title: The turn of the tide: Foreign investors return, signalling longer India bet
items.description: FPIs bought ₹53,172 crore of equities and ₹7,480 crore of government bonds in the first nine days of November, ending a 10-month streak of monthly equity outflows.

items.title: Wall St slips as hot inflation data fuels rate-hike jitters; Nvidia down 4%
items.description: Wall Street fell after stronger-than-expected US inflation data fuelled expectations of a December Fed rate hike, while Brent crude briefly dropped below $90 a barrel.

items.title: Individual ownership in NSE-listed firms hits record 19.5% in Q2FY27
items.description: Combined direct and mutual fund holdings of individuals reached ₹90.4 trillion in September, while FPI ownership fell to a 21-year low of 14.7 per cent, NSE data showed.

items.title: FPIs turn net buyers in November, pump ₹53,739 crore into Indian equities
items.description: Foreign investors infused ₹53,739 crore into Indian equities during November 2-9, reversing two months of outflows as the global AI sell-off, strong earnings and attractive valuations drew inflows
